description: This Java source file contains an implementation of the ModifyAttributesLiveCommand, an immutable class that extends AbstractModifyLiveCommand and implements the ModifyAttributesLiveCommand interface. It provides methods to create instances based on commands, access attributes, and set headers, specifically for modifying attributes in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ModifyAttributesLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of ModifyAttributesLiveCommand that encapsulates the logic for executing a modify attribute command within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyAttributesLiveCommandImpl from a Command object, casting it to ModifyAttributes.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the Attributes object associated with this command instance.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the command with the specified DittoHeaders set.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization; always returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides an answer builder instance for this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
